_comment: Rules, no AI. Maintained by the PM with counsel's input. Every entry here is a flag for a human to check, never a statement of law. Source: atliq_entities.md, the capstone brief, Client Meeting 1 (7 Oct 2026), Harrington huddle.

patient data.flag: Patient data in a US deal usually needs a HIPAA Business Associate Agreement (BAA), matching BAA or equivalent terms for every subcontractor or freelancer who touches the data, and no data transfer before those are signed. Confirm with counsel.

personal data (EU/UK).flag: EU or UK personal data usually needs a GDPR data processing agreement (DPA) with transfer terms for processing in India. Confirm with counsel.

guest data.flag: Guest or customer personal data of a Gulf client: check local data-protection and residency requirements (UAE PDPL, KSA PDPL). Confirm with counsel.

financial data.flag: Financial customer data in India: check the client's regulator requirements (RBI outsourcing rules for banks and NBFCs) and India's DPDP Act. Confirm with counsel.

client services: Master services agreement or services agreement
client services with patient data (US): Subcontractor BAA or equivalent for every freelancer or agency touching the data
Intercompany BAA covering the Pune delivery team
partnership: Check for exclusivity, non-compete and referral terms against the register
vendor or subcontractor: Flow-down of any client data terms (BAA, DPA) the subcontractor must match
freelancer: Flow-down of any client data terms the freelancer must match
nda: NDA only; check it is mutual if labelled mutual

escalation.note: Suggest escalation to counsel when a register conflict is found, a regulated data type is present, or liability or penalties are uncapped on a deal at or above this value. Threshold set by Karandeep, editable.
